_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% score-movement rate over 72 windows (0 of 72) makes HOLD the statistically honest default — the coil has not broken and a directional guess here is how the record hit 0-for-18, so we wait for the breaker with conviction rather than force a call.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — Analyst forward-calls Disbelief with medium conviction; Narrative stays in Denial framing. Both agree the setup is bullish-leaning but disagree on whether the phase transition has begun.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with spot ETF inflows turning positive and stablecoin_growth breaking above 55 — signals Disbelief→Hope transition with real money conviction
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 101 and BTC funding flipping negative — forces score down toward Anxiety/Panic band, killing the bottom analog
